correctedFields.value: Strongest feature: The move presents a disciplined evidentiary standard emphasizing reliable discrimination, specificity, independent confirmation, and bias reduction, while appropriately treating repeatability and falsifiability as ideals rather than exceptionless requirements. Principal limitation: It does not individually examine each explanatory virtue claimed for the divine account, and metaphysical evidence can remain rationally relevant without experimental repetition, causal isolation, or verification. Live burden: The standard must accommodate philosophical and historical evidence, identify sufficiently specific divine predictions, and demonstrate why the transcendental considerations fail comparatively instead of merely falling short of experimental ideals. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precise qualification, burden relevance, coherent hypothesis-sensitive reasoning, and charitable accommodation of nonexperimental evidence, tempered by incomplete application to the constructive case.

Strongest feature: The move challenges the theistic abduction and distinguishes reasonable ordinary inference from confidence in extraordinary candidates when the possibility space and alternatives remain understood. Principal limitation: Its claim of unreliability exceeds what the analogy establishes, because abduction can responsibly rank known explanations without an exhaustive candidate list when background frequencies and comparative expectations are independently justified. Live burden: The objection must specify the candidate set’s incompleteness, identify genuinely live omitted rivals, and explain why uncertainty about unknown possibilities materially weakens this divine comparison rather than every abductive inference. Locked score: The strong band reflects clear responsiveness, calibrated acknowledgment of ordinary cases, and substantial underdetermination pressure, moderated by an imprecise completeness threshold and no developed alternative account.
